{{% callout type="info" %}}
**Where to find it:** Applications & Components → Comma → Rebar → `uRebarStack` (also on the Comma ribbon tab, Rebar block)
{{% /callout %}}

Puts rebar groups against a source rebar group, using the actual (ribbed) bar diameters, by changing the covers of each target. It is the former Stack mode of [uRebarMatch](../urebarmatch/).

**How to use:**

1.  Select the target rebar groups in Tekla, or leave the selection empty. Choose the direction and the gap in the dialog and click **Apply**.
2.  Pick the source rebar group to stack against. When nothing was selected, pick the target rebar groups next and finish the picks with a middle-click.
3.  The status line says how many groups were changed. Groups that were not changed are listed with the reason in a message. The command then asks for the next source and repeats until <kbd>Esc</kbd>; the selection is used for the first round only.

| Option | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| **Direction** | *Next layer* changes the on-plane cover of the target, so its bars sit beside the source bars across the bar plane (for example the second bottom layer of a slab). With a stirrup as the source it puts the main bars against the inside of the stirrup leg parallel to them: pick the stirrup as the source and the main bars as the target. *Side by side* changes the start / end cover of the target, so its bars sit next to the source bars along the range. |
| **Gap** | The clear distance between the source bars and the target bars, in mm (0 = touching). |

Straight bars are moved; groups whose bar shape was drawn away from the start of the range are accepted. Every target is read back after the change and put back if the result is not the one that was planned.

{{% callout type="warning" %}}
After a native failure partial changes can remain: inspect the reported object and use Undo.
{{% /callout %}}
